scenario_name: Amber Fort emergency closure (VIP state visit)

trigger.reason: Sudden closure 14:00-17:00 for a VIP state visit (realistic, common occurrence)

original_plan_for_window.quality_note: Nahargarh visit cut to 35 of its recommended 120 min — misses most of sunset

recovery_plans.label: Reorder: swap fort visit order
recovery_plans.description: Go to Nahargarh Fort now for the full sunset window, return to Amber Fort right at 17:00 reopening for a quick highlights-only visit before 17:30 close.

steps.name: Amber Fort (highlights only: Ganesh Pol, main courtyard)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Same cost and time as original. You get the full sunset (better) but only 30 min inside Amber Fort (worse) instead of the reverse.

recovery_plans.label: Substitute: skip Amber Fort today, defer it
recovery_plans.description: Drop Amber Fort from today's plan. Fill the window with Albert Hall Museum and Johari Bazaar shopping instead. Amber Fort gets flagged for the 08:00 opening slot on the next available day (best light, no crowds).
recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 550 rupees and ends 45 min early (buffer/rest time). Amber Fort is deferred, not lost — auto-suggested for next day's 08:00 slot.
recovery_plans.best_for: Budget-conscious travelers, or multi-day trips with a free morning later

recovery_plans.label: Pivot: rest, then cultural evening at Chokhi Dhani
recovery_plans.description: Free time back at the hotel until early evening, then head straight to Chokhi Dhani for the cultural village experience, which already includes dinner — replacing a separately-planned dinner stop.

baseline_for_comparison.note: Compare against original window (700) plus a separate dinner you'd have paid anyway (~500 at Peacock Rooftop)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs about 200 more than the original plan + a normal dinner, but replaces a rushed fort visit with a full cultural evening and folds dinner into one stop.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who value one complete experience over squeezing in a second fort
